descriptions: Three-frame counting animation joins two counters to a group of three.

A small addition scene models a nonempty group receiving two more items.

params.question: Why does the platform use a topic tree before generating content?
options: To split the material into consistent semantic parts

descriptions: Single-choice quiz asks why the platform constructs a topic tree before writing content.
Three answer options check whether the reader understands semantic partitioning.
A question about the purpose of arranging document topics supplies one correct answer.
The learner distinguishes topic-based splitting from rendering and quota changes.

params.back: A self-contained fragment of the source document of about 15k tokens.

descriptions: A flip card tests recall of the definition of a semantic chunk.
The front asks about a chunk and the reverse supplies its meaning in document processing.
A two-sided study aid hides the explanation of a self-contained source fragment.
Recall the meaning of a semantic chunk before turning a revision card over.
An animation updates a parameter along a loss surface one gradient step at a time.
Watch an optimization point follow the slope toward a minimum.
successive frames track descent from a starting value across the loss curve.
The moving marker demonstrates iterative error minimization.
A sorting exercise orders upload, topic analysis, semantic splitting and content generation.
Drag the four document-processing stages into their chronological sequence.
Scrambled cards check the flow from source document to generated widgets.
Restore the proper order of the platform pipeline milestones.

params.text_with_blanks: The assistant charges quota with a ___ operation and returns the rest with a ___.

descriptions: A fill-in-the-blank prompt asks for reserve and refund in the quota ledger.
The learner supplies two missing operation names in a sentence about accounting.
A cloze exercise checks which actions debit and return reserved quota.
Complete a short statement describing reservation and reimbursement of the usage allowance.

An interactive plot relates excessive positive and negative scores to saturation.
